newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 17-THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 26.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 17-THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 26.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 17

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-28/95 A. Leur-Bloem v/ Inspecteur der Belastingdienst/Ondernemingen Amsterdam 2: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 177. Application of a community directive provision resulting from the execution of a national law subjecting to the policy of the directive hypotheses not covered by it. Interpretation of articles 2(d) and 11, paragraph 1(a) of Council directive 90/434/EEC of July 23, 1990, on the common system of taxation applicable to mergers, divisions, transfers of assets and exchanges of shares concerning companies of different Member States. Notion of exchange of shares. - Opinion C-130/95 Bernd Giloy v/ Hauptzollamt Frankfurt am Main-Ost: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 244, paragraph 2 of Council regulation 2913/92 of October 12, 1992, establishing the Community Customs Code. Decision requiring the payment of import duties. Doubt as to the conformity of the decision to Customs regulations. Risk to interested party of irreparable damages. Alternative or accumulative conditions for stay of execution. - Opinion joined cases C-34/95, C-35/95 and C-36/95 Konsumentombudsmannen (KO) v/ De Agostini (Svenska) Foerlag AB and others: free movement of persons. Interpretation of article 59 of EC treaty and of Council directive 89/552/EEC on the co-ordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions concerning televised radio broadcasting activities. National law banning advertising specifically directed at children. Televised advertisement broadcast by another member state and transmitted by satellite.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cased C-246/94, C-247/94, C-248/94 and C-249/94 Cooperativa Agricola Zootecnica S. Antonio and others v/ Amministrazione delle Finanze dello Stato and others: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 2(d) of Council directive 79/623/EEC of June 25, 1979, on the co-ordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions in matters relating to Customs debt. Customs debt - exclusion under special import policy. Non execution of secondary obligations. Consequences. Loss of deposit in proportion to length of delay. Principle of proportionality. Validity of article 1, paragraph 2 of Commission regulation 1121/87 amending Commission regulation 612/77 of March 24, 1977, laying down modes of application regarding special import policy on certain young male bovines intended for fattening. - Judgment C-289/94 Commission v/ Italy: approximation of legislation. Non respect. Articles 8 and 9 of Council directive 83/189/EEC of March 28, 1983, providing for an information procedure in the field of technical norms and regulations. Non transmission of four draft decrees by the health ministry.
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 18

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-149/94, T-181/94 Kernkraftwerke Lippe-Ems v/ Commission: procurement. Annulment of Commission decision K(94) 243 final, of February 4, 1994, on a natural uranium supply contract submitted by the claimant to the Euratom supply agency and later deferred to the Commission in accordance with article 53, paragraph to of the EAEC treaty.

FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-155/94 Climax Paper Converters v/ Council: commercial policy. Annulment of Council regulation 3664/93 of December 22, 1993, imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports into the Community of photo albums in book-bound form originating in the People's Republic of China and collecting definitively the provisional anti-dumping duty. - Judgment T-387/94 Asia Motor France and others v/ Commission: competition. Annulment of Commission decision of October 13, 1994, to reject complaints made by claimants on the grounds of EC treaty article 85 and concerning the import into France of Japanese brand vehicles from EC member states where they are admitted freely. Execution of judgment of June 29, 1993, rendered by the Court in case T-7/92. Appeal for responsibility and damages aimed at reparation of the damages caused by the Commission's behaviour. - Oral procedure T-105/95 WWF UK v/ Commission: institutional law. Annulment of Commission decision of February 2, 1995, refusing the claimant access to documents related to the "Mullaghmore project", on the use of community structural funds for the construction of a visitor's centre at Burren National Park (Ireland).
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 19

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-42/95 Siemens AG v/ Henry Nold: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 29, paragraphs 1 and 4 of Council directive 77/91/EEC: second council directive of December 13, 1976, on co-ordination of safeguards which, for the protection of the interests of members and others, are required by Member States of companies within the meaning of the second paragraph of article 58 of the Treaty, in respect of the formation of public limited liability companies and the maintenance and alteration of their capital, with a view to making such safeguards equivalent. Increase of a limited liability company's capital by contributions in kind - exclusion. - Opinion C-66/95 The Queen, ex parte Eunice Sutton v/ Secretary of State for Social Security: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Payments granted retroactively. Right of beneficiary to interest.

FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-38/95 Ministero delle Finanze v/ Foods Import Srl: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 20 of regulation 3796/81 of December 29, 1981, organising common markets in the fishing sector. Applicability to whiting of the "Molva" variety. Interpretation of article 5, paragraph 2 of Council regulation 1697/79 of July 24, 1979, on the "a posteriors" covering of export duties not required of the concerned party for goods declared for a customs regime including the obligation to pay such duties. Exemption from customs duties of whiting and whiting fillets. Administrative error.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-153/95 ANDRE en Co, NV v/ Belgische Staat: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 8, paragraph 2(b) of Commission regulation 926/80 of April 15, 1980, on the exoneration in certain cases of the application of compensatory monetary sums. Export of products to which the new MCM applies. Export preceded by the import of the products at least six months previously.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-236/95 Commission v/ Greece: company law. Non respect. Failure to have transformed within the prescribed period Council directive 89/665 of December 21, 1989, on the co-ordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions as they apply to appeal procedures for public procurement supply contracts. - Opinion C-96/95 Commission v/ Germany: free movement of persons. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 90/364/EEC of June 28, 1990, on the right of stay and 90/365/EEC of June 28, 1990, on the right of stay of salaried and non salaried workers having ceased their professional activity. - Opinion C-178/95 Wiljo NV v/ Belgische Staat: transport. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 8, paragraph 3(c) of Council regulation 1101/89 of April 27, 1989, on the structural improvements in inland waterway transport. Special contribution for the putting into service of newly built boats. Exclusion of "specialised boat". Notion.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-115/94 Opel Austria (formerly General Motors Austria v/ Council: external relations. Annulment of Council regulation 3697/93 of December 20, 1993, withdrawing tariff concessions in accordance with Article 23 (2) and article 27(a) of the Free Trade Agreement between the Community and Austria (General Motors Austria). Community and Austria accord. Consultation mechanisms and controversial regulations. Compatibility of an aid with the accord. EEE Accord. Ban on customs tariffs. Applicability of GATT regulation 2423/88. Procedure for taking compensatory measures.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 24-26
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 24

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-124/95 The Queen ex parte: Centro-Com Srl v/ H.M. Treasury and others: trade policy. - Oral procedure C-183/95 Affish BV v/ Rigksdienst voor de Keuring van Vee en Vlees: agriculture. - (1100/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-250/95 Futura Participation SA and others v/ Administration des contributions: free movement of persons.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-485/93 Louis Dreyfus v/ Commission: external relations. - Judgment T-491/93 Richco Commodities v/ Commission: external relations. - Judgment T-494/93 Compagnie Continentale (France) v/ Commission: external relations. - Judgment T-509/93 Richco Commodities v/ Commission: external relations.

THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-57/91 NALOO v/ Commission: competition. - Judgment T-24/93 Compagnie Maritime Belge Transports and others v/ Commission: competition. - Judgment T-25/93 Dafra-Lines v/ Commission: competition. - Judgment T-26/93 Deutsche Afrika-Linien v/ Commission: competition. - Judgment C-Nedlloyd Lijnen v/ Commission: competition.
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 26
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-120/95 Nicolas Deckeer v/ Caisse de maladie des employes prives: free movement of goods.
SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-105/94 Ditta Angelo Celestini v/ Saar-Sektkellerei Faber: agriculture.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-230/94 Renate Enkler v/ Finanzamt Homburg: taxation. - Judgment C-168/95 Luciano Arcaro: environment and consumers.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-47/95 to C-50/95, C-60/95, C-81/95, C-92/95, C-148/95: membership of new states.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-302/93 E. Debouche v/ Inspecteur der Invoerrechten en Accijnzen: taxation. - Judgment C-287/94 A/S Richard Frederiksen & Co. v/ Skatteministeriet: taxation. - Judgment C-327/94 Juergen Dudda v/ Finanzamt Bergisch Gladbach: taxation. - Judgment C-341/94 Andre Allain v/ Ministere public: free movement of goods. - Judgment C-43/95 Data Delecta Aktiebolag and others v/ MSL Dynamics Ltd: principles of community law. - Judgment C-79/95 Commission v/ Spain: social policy. - Judgment C-117/95 Commission v/ Italy: agriculture. - Opinion C-69/94 France v/ commission: agriculture. - Opinion C-150/94 United Kingdom v/ Council: trade policy. - Opinion C-284/94 Spain v/ Council: trade policy. - Opinion C-29/95 Eckehard Pastoors and others v/ Belgium state: principles of community law. - Opinion C-106/95 Mainschiffahrts-Genossenschaft eG (MSG) v/ Les Gravieres Rhenanes SARL: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. - Oral procedure C-134/95 USSL n. 47 di Biella v/ Istituto nazionale per Llassicurazione contre gli infortuni sul lavora (INAIL): free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-90/94 Haahr Petroleum Ltd v/ Aabenraa Havn and others: free movement of goods. - Oral procedure joined cases C-114/95 and C-115/95 Texaco A/S v/ Middelfart Havn and others and Esbjerg Havn and others, and olieselskabet Danmark amba v/ Trafikministeriet and Frederica Kommune and others: free movement of goods.
